_description: PYRO-ASTRA Comprehensive Schema Data Dictionary (Investigation Schema & Modeling-Ready Runs)
_license_statement: There are no restrictions on the use of this data. (Registry of Open Data on AWS, https://registry.opendata.aws/nasa-psi/)

_rules_governance.G1_strict_nulls: Never invent, estimate, round up or interpolate a value. If PSI does not state it, store null and show 'not reported'.
_rules_governance.G1_row_provenance: Every single row carries authentic {file, sha256, row id, column, unit_conversion_note}.
_rules_governance.G1_exact_unit_conversions: Unit conversions are allowed only with an exact formula (e.g. 1 mmHg = 14.6959488/760 psi, 1 bar = 14.50377 psi, 1 atm = 14.6959 psi).
_rules_governance.G1_oxygen_isolation: Oxygen in burner oxidizer flow (e.g. CFI-G, Flame Design) is NOT cabin oxygen. Separate fields and separate labels everywhere.
_rules_governance.G1_zero_partial_gravity: PSI has zero partial-gravity data. Never show a partial-gravity prediction. ACME E-FIELD Flames is electric-field-analog only.

fields.name: license

fields.description: Indicates whether metadata and DOI have been verified against official NASA PSI records.

fields.name: depth

fields.name: data_origin

fields.name: hardware

fields.name: objectives
fields.description: Primary scientific and engineering goals.

fields.name: sample_shape
fields.description: Geometric configuration of fuel samples (e.g. flat strips, rods, droplets, wicks).

fields.name: sample_size

fields.name: cabin_o2_pct
fields.description: Ambient crew cabin oxygen volume percentage tested. Must NOT be confused with burner flow oxygen.

fields.name: burner_flow_o2_pct
fields.description: Oxygen percentage in gas burner feed line (e.g. ACME CFI-G up to 85%). Strictly isolated from cabin O2.

fields.name: pressure_psi
fields.description: Ambient environmental chamber pressure. Converted with exact formula (1 psi = 6.894757 kPa; 1 atm = 14.6959 psi).

fields.name: airflow_speed_cm_s
fields.description: Forced convective airflow velocity along the sample.

fields.name: varied_variables
fields.description: Parameters systematically varied in the experimental test matrix.

fields.name: constant_variables
fields.description: Parameters held constant across test series.

fields.name: sensors
fields.description: Diagnostic instruments, sensors, cameras, and radiometers deployed.

fields.name: n_tests
fields.description: Count of documented flight or ground test runs.

fields.name: not_reported
fields.description: Automated ledger of core physical fields where NASA PSI did not state a value (Rule 1).

fields.name: run_id
fields.description: Globally unique identifier for each experimental run across all NASA PSI datasets.

fields.name: investigation_id
fields.description: Parent NASA Physical Sciences Informatics investigation identifier.

fields.name: investigation_acronym
fields.description: Official experiment acronym.

fields.name: source_table
fields.description: Source experimental CSV table filename or report table identifier.

fields.name: test_id
fields.description: Original test or sample number from primary NASA table.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Date or GMT day of test execution aboard ISS or flight platform.

fields.name: gravity_regime
fields.description: Gravitational environment. Microgravity for flight runs; 1g for companion ground tests; electric-field-analog for PSI-22. Partial-gravity is strictly prohibited.

fields.name: is_suspect
fields.description: Quality flag indicating suspect or anomalous test data (e.g. final O2 > initial O2 or negative airflow).

fields.name: suspect_reason
fields.description: Scientific justification for suspect flag.
fields.example: Calibrated final O2 exceeds initial O2

fields.name: group_condition
fields.description: Grouping key for leave-one-condition-out grouped cross-validation in machine learning pipelines.

fields.name: fuel_raw
fields.description: Verbatim fuel or combustible material string from authentic NASA table.

fields.name: material_class
fields.description: Normalized physical material classification.

fields.name: fuel_phase
fields.description: Physical phase of the combustible fuel. Enforces fuel-phase partition protocol.

fields.name: cabin_o2_pct
fields.description: Ambient crew cabin or chamber oxygen concentration (% vol). Converted from mole fraction (1.0 mole frac = 100%). Strictly null for burner oxidizer feeds.

fields.name: burner_flow_o2_pct
fields.description: Burner oxidizer feed oxygen concentration (% vol). Populated for CFI-G and Flame Design; strictly null for cabin life support atmospheres.

fields.name: pressure_psi
fields.description: Ambient environmental chamber pressure converted to psi using exact formula (1 mmHg = 14.6959488/760 psi, 1 bar = 100000/6894.757 psi, 1 atm = 14.69595 psi).

fields.name: pressure_raw_value
fields.description: Original raw numeric pressure value from source table before unit conversion.

fields.name: pressure_raw_unit
fields.description: Original physical pressure unit stated in source table header ('mmHg', 'bar', 'atm', or null).

fields.name: airflow_speed_cm_s
fields.description: Forced convective airflow velocity along the sample in cm/s. Null when only instrument dial values are reported.

fields.name: temperature_c
fields.description: Chamber ambient temperature in degrees Celsius.

fields.name: sample_shape
fields.description: Specimen geometrical form factor ('flat slab', 'film', 'rod', 'droplet', 'burner nozzle', etc.).

fields.name: sample_thickness_mm
fields.description: Solid fuel sample thickness in millimeters.

fields.name: sample_width_cm
fields.description: Sample width in centimeters.

fields.name: sample_length_cm
fields.description: Sample length in centimeters.

fields.name: initial_diameter_mm
fields.description: Initial droplet, burner nozzle, or rod diameter in millimeters.

fields.name: flame_spread_rate_mm_s
fields.description: Measured solid flame spread rate in mm/s (reported in BASS-II Table 5.1).

fields.name: burn_duration_s
fields.description: Total burn duration or observation period in seconds.

fields.name: extinction_diameter_mm
fields.description: Droplet diameter at visible flame extinction in mm (FLEX).

fields.name: burning_rate_mm2_s
fields.description: Droplet burning rate constant (d²-law slope) in mm²/s.

fields.name: weight_loss_rate_mg_min
fields.description: Fuel pyrolysis weight loss rate in mg/min (SAME).

fields.name: smoke_inlet_velocity_cm_s
fields.description: Inlet flow velocity in smoke aerosol chamber in cm/s (SAME-R).

fields.name: particle_aging_time_s
fields.description: Smoke particle residence and agglomeration aging duration in seconds (SAME/SAME-R).

fields.name: calibrated_initial_o2_pct
fields.description: Calibrated initial oxygen concentration before ignition in % vol (BASS-II).

fields.name: calibrated_final_o2_pct
fields.description: Calibrated final oxygen concentration post-burn in % vol (BASS-II).

fields.name: initial_co2_pct
fields.description: Initial CO2 concentration in % vol (BASS-II).

fields.name: final_co2_pct
fields.description: Final post-combustion CO2 concentration in % vol (BASS-II).

fields.name: initial_co_ppm
fields.description: Initial carbon monoxide concentration in ppm (BASS-II).

fields.name: final_co_ppm
fields.description: Final post-combustion carbon monoxide concentration in ppm (BASS-II).

fields.name: adiabatic_flame_temp_k
fields.description: Theoretical adiabatic flame temperature Tad in Kelvin (CFI-G / Flame Design).

fields.name: provenance_file
fields.description: Relative repository path to authentic NASA source CSV file or technical report.

fields.name: provenance_file_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 SHA-256 hash of the authentic source file for tamper-evident data integrity.

fields.name: provenance_row_id
fields.description: Authentic row identifier or test number in the source table.

fields.name: provenance_column
fields.description: Primary source column header from authentic table.

fields.name: provenance_note
fields.description: Exact unit conversion mathematical formula or grounding provenance citation.
fields.example: Exact pressure conversion: 1 mmHg = 14.6959487755134 / 760 psi = 0.0193367747 psi
